name: Jánoshalma (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Jánoshalma (a crowned blue shield with a black bird, a white bird and a bunch of grapes, within a green wreath) above the name JÁNOSHALMA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jánoshalma arms with crown and wreath
